title: Four cyclic components with averaged intersections and cumulative occupancy with exact signed parity shells

claims.statement: The explicit product of four five-field degree-50 cyclic codes, with its fixed radius-14 adaptive list decoder, carries 1000 bits on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses with average block error at most 145402182478988261/250000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=1973347810622310008344 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(35371/500).

experiments.purpose: Check exact QR profiles, field, orbits and primitive bound (0), all 65 averaged pair cutoffs with exact signed shell sums (1), exact child removal counts by noise weight (2), and full cumulative occupancy and error (3).
